mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate reduces the risk-free discount rate for equity valuation, compressing the present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of the time when FEDFUNDS is below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points in a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of the time when UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts exceeding 0.5% in a one-month window signals a contraction in real economic output, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and HOUST decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of the time when INDPRO and HOUST both decline by more than 0.5% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 5.0% signals reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of the time when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% during a monetary tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 0.5% in a one-month window signals robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of the time when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% in one month.

mechanism_narrative: A high retail sales level relative to its 12-month moving average indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of the time when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate combined with a low federal funds rate signals recessionary economic conditions with aggressive monetary policy, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of the time when UNRATE > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing slowdown regime, a decline in industrial production below 100 signals deteriorating output conditions, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of the time when INDPRO is below 100.
